subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The crow at last thought of a plan to get rid of her enemy. (b) She stole an expensive neckless of the prince from the royal palace nearby and dropped it into the snake's hole after scattering a few rubles here and there. (c) A snake lived in a hole at the foot of a tree. (d) The king was very angry at the loss and sent out men to look for the neckless . (e) High up on it's branches was the nest of a crow. (f) In this way the snake ate up three of the chicks. (g) The crow had four young ones in its nest. (h) Whenever the crow would leave the nest to bring food for its chicks, the snake would climp up and eat up ones. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (c) + (e) + (g) + (h) + (f) + (a) + (b) + (d) Section B : Writing Test
